items.job: Remove oil pan and valve covers, clean out sludge, fresh oil
items.note: If the engine already knocks or has seized, a used or rebuilt engine is needed and costs much more.

items.job: Remove head, install thread inserts, new head gasket and bolts
items.note: Cost rises a lot if overheating warped the head or damaged the engine.

items.job: Reprogram transmission computer and check fluid
items.note: If the transmission is worn and the update does not help, a rebuild costs much more.
Toyota's old ZE7 coverage has mostly ended; ask a dealer anyway. A used engine can cost less than a ring job.
Toyota's past dash program has likely ended. A fitted dash cover is a far cheaper fix for glare.

items.t: Driver's power window switch can overheat (recall)
items.note: Usually free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Toyota dealer first.

items.t: Accelerator pedal can be trapped by floor mat (recall)
items.job: Modify or replace accelerator pedal and fit correct mats
items.note: Done free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Toyota dealer.

items.job: Replace rubber VVT-i oil hose with updated metal line
items.note: Often free under a Toyota service campaign. Check your VIN. Cost rises a lot if the engine ran low on oil.

items.t: Hybrid brake actuator or brake control unit failure
items.job: Replace hybrid brake actuator and bleed brakes
items.note: Toyota extended coverage on some cars. Check your VIN with a dealer. Used actuators cost less but carry risk.

items.job: Replace torque converter (after software update fails)
items.note: Try the dealer software update first; it is much cheaper and fixes some cars.

items.t: Water leak onto airbag control module (recall)
items.job: Replace airbag control module and seal the leak
items.note: Covered by the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Toyota dealer.

items.t: Musty or moldy smell from the A/C
items.job: Clean A/C evaporator and replace cabin air filter
items.note: If the smell keeps coming back, replacing the evaporator costs much more.
